tool.name: gff3ToGenePred
tool.command: gff3ToGenePred $use_name $warn_and_continue $process_all_gene_children $allow_minimal_genes '$input' '$output' && if [ ! -s '$output' ]; then echo 'No transcripts were converted. Check the structure of the GFF3 file, or try the options.' >&2; exit 1; fi

param.name: use_name
param.label: Name transcripts from the Name attribute
param.help: By default, the tool uses transcript_id first, then transcript_name, then Name.

param.name: warn_and_continue
param.label: Skip transcripts that the tool cannot convert
param.help: Write a warning for each skipped transcript. By default, the tool stops with an error.

param.name: process_all_gene_children
param.label: Convert all children of a gene
param.help: Convert every child of a gene, whatever its feature type.

param.name: allow_minimal_genes
param.label: Convert genes without transcripts
param.help: Convert genes that have exons as direct children, and genes that have no children.

tool.help:
**What it does**
gff3ToGenePred converts gene models in a [GFF3](https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/Specifications/blob/master/gff3.md) file to the UCSC [genePred format](https://genome.ucsc.edu/FAQ/FAQformat.html#format9). To make a gene track for a genome browser, convert the genePred file to BED12 with genePredToBed. Then convert the BED12 file to bigBed with bedToBigBed.
-----
**Input**
A GFF3 file. The tool expects genes that contain transcripts (mRNA, ncRNA, rRNA or transcript), and transcripts that contain exons or CDS. Use the options for files with a different structure. If the tool converts no transcripts, the job fails.
**Output**
A genePred table with one line for each transcript. It has 15 columns: name, chrom, strand, txStart, txEnd, cdsStart, cdsEnd, exonCount, exonStarts, exonEnds, score, name2 (gene name), cdsStartStat, cdsEndStat, exonFrames.
-----
**More information**
- [gff3ToGenePred source code](https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/tree/master/src/hg/utils/gff3ToGenePred)
